00001 MODULE branchmod

00006   FUNCTION branching(r1,r2,pr)
00007     ! On first call, ultimately populate global PRODS array with three values,
00008     ! chosen based on the reaction selected. If there is more than one pathway,
00009     ! choose one based on it's relative rate-coefficient, if available, or equal
00010     ! weight statistical probability if not.
00011     IMPLICIT NONE
00012     INTEGER :: branching
00013     INTEGER :: r1,r2,pr ! Indices of the reaction look-up-table
00014     INTEGER :: prods(3)

00016     REAL    :: rnum

00018     TYPE(reaction), POINTER :: re_temp
00019     TYPE(reaction_info) :: pathways(2)
00020     DOUBLE PRECISION :: val1, val2

00022     DOUBLE PRECISION :: barrier
00023 
00024     reaction = 0
00025     varfmt = "(5I10,ES15.4)"
00026 
00027     firstcall: IF ( pr .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00028        ! Initialize pathways data structure
00029        PRODS = 0
00030        val1    = 0
00031        val2    = 0
00032        prob1   = 0
00033        prob2   = 0
00034        barrier = 0
00035        initpaths: DO n=1,2
00036           pathways(n)%nr1 = 0
00037           pathways(n)%nr2 = 0

00039           pathways(n)%np2 = 0
00040           pathways(n)%np3 = 0
00041           pathways(n)%arrh_alpha = 0
00042           pathways(n)%arrh_beta = 0
00043           pathways(n)%arrh_gamma = 0
00044           pathways(n)%rtype = 0
00045        END DO initpaths
00046 
00047        ! 1. Go through list of reactions and find all between r1 and r2
00048        re_temp => RE_HEAD
00049        n = 0
00050        getpaths: DO
00051           IF ( .NOT. ASSOCIATED(re_temp%next)) EXIT
00052           IF ( ((re_temp%nr1 .EQ. r1) .AND. (re_temp%nr2 .EQ. r2)) .OR. &
00053                ((re_temp%nr1 .EQ. r2) .AND. (re_temp%nr2 .EQ. r1)) ) THEN
00054              n = n + 1
00055              pathways(n)%nr1 = re_temp%nr1
00056              pathways(n)%nr2 = re_temp%nr2
00057              pathways(n)%np1 = re_temp%np1
00058              pathways(n)%np2 = re_temp%np2
00059              pathways(n)%np3 = re_temp%np3
00060              pathways(n)%arrh_alpha = re_temp%arrh_alpha
00061              pathways(n)%arrh_beta = re_temp%arrh_beta
00062              pathways(n)%arrh_gamma = re_temp%arrh_gamma
00063              pathways(n)%rtype = re_temp%rtype
00064           END IF
00065           re_temp => re_temp%next
00066        END DO getpaths
00067 
00068        onepath: IF ( n .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00069           ! 2. If there is just one possible reaction, proceed, else, calculate rate coeff.
00070           PRODS(1) = pathways(1)%np1
00071           PRODS(2) = pathways(1)%np2
00072           PRODS(3) = pathways(1)%np3
00073           barrier  = pathways(1)%arrh_gamma
00074        ElSE

00076              ! If pathways rtype is not the same, we can't compare them directly

00080 
00081           ! 3. Based on reaction type, calculate rate coeff. and store that in data-structure
00082           SELECT CASE (pathways(1)%rtype)
00083           CASE(1)
00084              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00085              CALL EXIT()
00086           CASE(2)
00087              val1 = arrhenius(&
00088                   pathways(1)%arrh_alpha,&
00089                   pathways(1)%arrh_beta,&
00090                   pathways(1)%arrh_gamma)
00091              val2 = arrhenius(&
00092                   pathways(2)%arrh_alpha,&
00093                   pathways(2)%arrh_beta,&
00094                   pathways(2)%arrh_gamma)
00095           CASE(3)
00096              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00097              CALL EXIT()
00098           CASE(4)
00099              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00100              CALL EXIT()
00101           CASE(5)
00102              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00103              CALL EXIT()
00104           CASE(6)
00105              val1 = pathways(1)%arrh_alpha
00106              val2 = pathways(2)%arrh_alpha
00107           CASE(7)
00108              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00109              CALL EXIT()
00110           CASE(8)
00111              PRINT *, "Case",pathways(1)%rtype,"is not implemented!"
00112              CALL EXIT()
00113           END SELECT
00114 
00115           ! 4. Call a random number and select pathway based on result
00116           prob1 = val1/(val1+val2)
00117           prob2 = val2/(val1+val2)
00118           CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand)
00119 
00120           ! 5. Populate PRODS array with result
00121           IF ( rand .LE. prob1 ) THEN
00122              PRODS(1) = pathways(1)%p1
00123              PRODS(2) = pathways(1)%p2
00124              PRODS(3) = pathways(1)%p3
00125              barrier  = pathways(1)%arrh_gamma
00126           ELSE
00127              PRODS(1) = pathways(2)%p1
00128              PRODS(2) = pathways(2)%p2
00129              PRODS(3) = pathways(2)%p3
00130              barrier  = pathways(2)

00134        ! 6. If there is a barrier to the selected pathway, engage the competition mechanism

00136        e_d = E_BULK*EN_LIST(r1)
00137        prob1 = e_d/(e_d+barrier)
00138        prob2 = barrier/(e_d+barrier)

00140        IF ( rand .LE. prob1 ) THEN
00141           PRODS(1) = 0
00142           PRODS(2) = 0
00143           PRODS(3) = 0
00144        END IF
